entries.proposition: DESIGN: one experiment, adult male Sprague Dawley rats, 8 per group, focal micro-infusion of bicuculline into the anterior piriform cortex (area tempestas) five minutes after salbutamol, butoxamine, or both; methods are in a supplementary file.
entries.snippet: in Sprague Dawley male adult rats, pre-infusion of β2-AR agonist salbutamol (10 nmol) prevents focally serial seizures evoked by bicuculline (118 pmol)

entries.proposition: The abstract says salbutamol FULLY prevents limbic seizures; the figure caption gives 3 of 8 rats (37.5 percent) still seizing after salbutamol plus bicuculline, so prevention was complete in 5 of 8.
entries.snippet: Butox=0%, N=0/8; Salbut+Bic= 37.5%, N=3/8; Butox + Bic=100%, N=8/8

entries.proposition: Figure 1 shows the incidence bars: bicuculline 100, salbutamol alone 0, butoxamine alone 0, salbutamol plus bicuculline about 37, butoxamine plus bicuculline 100, triple 100; the incidence ceiling of 100 percent in the control means the antagonist cannot be shown to raise incidence, only severity.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1 bars of percent of rats with seizures: Bic 100, Salbut 0, Butox 0, Salbut+Bic about 37 with asterisk, Butox+Bic 100, Butox+Salbut+Bic 100; y axis 0 to 110.

experimental_context.system: adult male rat, anterior piriform cortex micro-infusion, bicuculline model
experimental_context.treatment: salbutamol 10 nmol, butoxamine 10 umol, bicuculline 118 pmol
experimental_context.endpoint: percent of rats with seizures, N 8 per group

entries.proposition: Severity: butoxamine plus bicuculline raised time to last seizure (72 against 47 minutes) and maximum seizure score (4.25 against 2.5); salbutamol plus bicuculline lowered both (16.3 minutes, 0.5). Mean and spread are given; the test is not stated in the article body.
The antagonist effect is stated to be sometimes enough to convert serial seizures into self-sustaining status epilepticus; no count of such conversions is given in the article.
entries.snippet: antagonism at β2-AR within AT does not merely worsen seizures being sometimes sufficient in converting serial seizures into self-sustaining, long-lasting SE

entries.proposition: The autophagy link is argued from other literature and is not measured here: the paper itself says the link between receptor stimulation and autophagy still needs to be established.
entries.snippet: a link between ARs stimulation and autophagy needs to be established concerning seizure onset from AT

entries.proposition: The authors concede the data are focal and that systemic receptor effects (temperature, blood pressure, neuroendocrine, blood-brain barrier) would alter seizure threshold under a systemic chemoconvulsant.
entries.snippet: when seizures are induced through systemic administration of chemoconvulsants, even systemic effects induced by β-AR become relevant

entries.proposition: Translation claim: rat piriform data are said to bear translational relevance because neural networks are preserved through phylogenesis; this is an assertion, offered without a human datum.
entries.snippet: pharmacological data obtained from AT in rats bear translational relevance in humans
